author: Justin Hawkins Rides Again
description:
🎟️ To come and see Justin Hawkins Rides Again LIVE across the UK in January and February, find tickets here: 
https://www.aegpresents.co.uk/event/justin-hawkins-rides-again/
🎟️ For VIP upgrades: https://thejawsofvictory.com/pages/justin-hawkins-rides-again?srsltid=AfmBOorryy6x7BKwj8HeKF7R1Jdtat6hl3fNPuhRJfMpQWxpCC2o1IqT

I'm on the road with my live show - Justin Hawkins Rides Again - Again - and as on my channel, I'm talking to bands you may not have heard of (or maybe you have). In Chester, I met The Royston Club from nearby Wrexham in Wales and reviewed their song Cariad https://youtu.be/0rwDr8bmeGE?si=ImR9AS1Ydem-IFB2 
Before I left to go on tour, I listened to Shivers from their latest album Songs For The Spine - so this is my review of that song!
